6. Provide a conclusion.

## Detailed guidance for processing the inspection record

### Step 0: Determine which inspection record to draw data from

This can be done via the `inspectionID` field (`inspection | unique(inspectionID)`).

Use `event_type` (`InspectionItem | selectAll(event_type)`). 

*Make a note of these checks, as well as what day the test was performed.*
